explanation: Replacing `which` (an external binary) with `command -v` (a shell built-in) and passing it directly to `subprocess.call` without `shell=True` will cause a `FileNotFoundError` on systems where `command` is not an executable in PATH, silently setting `srun_exists = False` and suppressing the srun warning even when srun is present.
